items.title: America.gov gets really weird when you ask it about Minecraft, but it’s not a glitch
items.summary: For the sake of national security, it's a relief to learn that America.gov is not hallucinating to the point that it's penning lengthy poetry.

items.title: The internet is convinced Elon Musk’s xAI trolled OpenAI’s ‘Dots’ launch
items.summary: Before OpenAI launched its new AI agent, Dots, on Tuesday, Elon Musk's xAI had already acquired the domain name "dot.com," which now redirects to the Grok chatbot download page.

items.title: Your car and its mobile app are probably handing over all kinds of data to tech companies
items.summary: Researchers at Northeastern University found vehicles and their companion apps regularly shared detailed data with some of the largest tech companies.

items.title: a16z-backed EliseAI raises $350M, doubles valuation to $4B
items.summary: EliseAI raises $350M, doubles valuation in a year.

items.title: Tesla secures $30B in new credit lines as it looks to scale Cybercab, Optimus
items.summary: The company says it won't draw on the new debt facilities this year, as it has already planned at least $25 billion in capital expenditures.

items.title: OpenAI’s latest features take direct aim at the app store model
items.summary: OpenAI is building out the pieces of an alternative to the traditional app store model, turning ChatGPT into a place where software can be discovered and used by people and AI agents alike.

items.title: OpenAI reportedly in talks to raise $30B round at $1.4T valuation
items.summary: The new round is anticipated to be the company's last before its delayed 2027 public debut.

items.title: More Ways to Disrupt: New 2026 Side Events from KOTRA, WayFounder, Enterprise Ireland, SafetyWing + Descope
items.summary: Disrupt doesn’t end when you leave Moscone West. 👀 Founder dinners, investor meetups, happy hours, workshops, roundtables and more are taking over San Francisco during Disrupt Week. See what’s happening, find your people, and start building your calendar.

items.title: Apple Pay set to launch in India with Axis Bank today, sources say
items.summary: Some of India's largest banks are holding off on supporting Apple Pay initially.

items.title: Here’s why OpenAI is absent from Nvidia’s industry-wide effort to end rogue AI agents
items.summary: OpenAI isn't a public supporter of Nvidia's Open Agent Safety Platform, but it is privately working with Nvidia, TechCrunch has learned.

items.title: OpenAI takes on Microsoft with the launch of what feels a whole lot like ChatGPT’s own office suite
items.summary: OpenAI's newly announced suite of office features puts it into more direct competition with more traditional software companies.

items.title: Dutch police arrest ShinyHunters hacker accused of planning two murders
items.summary: Dutch police said the hacker, arrested for being part of the ShinyHunters cybercriminal gang, had plans to organize the murder of two people on his laptop.

items.title: AI-powered app maker Wabi pivots to a messaging experience
items.summary: Wabi is repositioning its prompt-based app builder as a personal AI agent that can create interfaces on demand, combining chat, apps, and ongoing tasks.

items.title: OpenAI launches Dots, its bubbly agentic avatar
items.summary: Dots are meant to operate independent of any specific hardware or interface, pursuing user-defined goals continuously in the background with minimal oversight.

items.title: OpenAI gives Codex reusable cloud environments that work across devices
items.summary: OpenAI is expanding Codex with reusable cloud development environments, a revamped CLI with voice controls, new code review tools, and a security-focused product for scanning repositories and preparing fixes.

items.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6.1 Sol, says it nearly matches GPT-6 Astra and costs less
items.summary: OpenAI says GPT-6.1 Sol delivers significant improvements over GPT-6 Sol across complex professional tasks, including code writing and debugging, document understanding, and executing multistep business workflows.

items.title: OpenAI expands ChatGPT’s plug-ins with app-like interfaces and automations
items.summary: OpenAI is expanding ChatGPT plug-ins with dedicated sidebar homes, interactive panels, file viewers, improved discovery, and support for automations.

items.title: Can a chatbot fix the government maze? The White House is about to find out
items.summary: America.gov is intended to simplify the process of navigating government bureaucracy, but large language models are imperfect and remain prone to hallucinations, which could cause new issues.

items.title: Instinct founder said more than 50% of transactions on the platform are travel-related
items.summary: Instinct founder said the platform is growing 10% day by day, with transaction volume increasing at a similar rate.

items.title: After losing his voice to cancer, this founder is building ‘glasses for voice’
items.summary: Uhura Bionics, part of the Startup Battlefield 200 at TechCrunch Disrupt, wants to replace flat, robotics voice devices with one that carries emotions.
